blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — City councilors here are questioning the priority of a proposed P7-million refrigerated van for farmers, saying the city should first address water shortages in upland barangays as El Niño threatens agricultural production. The City Council’s Committee on Agriculture and Rural Development recommended against proceeding with the immediate procurement, citing the lack of a comprehensive El Niño preparedness and response plan from the City Agriculture Department (CAD), as well as insufficient justification for the vehicle’s urgency and necessity.
